verdict.what: a black-framed glass storefront shop or saloon with checkered floor trim
verdict.style: modern-retro commercial storefront, black and glass with a checkerboard base
verdict.looks: A long single-storey box with a light grey-beige flat roof band and a thin tan cap. The walls are near-black, broken by large panes of glass in pale-teal mullioned grids. Dark pilasters divide the bays. The base is a checkerboard of dark grey and light stone blocks. Inside, visible tan and brown furniture, crates and a wooden door with a gold knob. Potted plants or props sit in some windows. The lower-right side view shows a narrow end bay. The walls and roof are clean and uniform, with no holes or floating blocks.
verdict.summary: A clean black-and-glass storefront with a readable checkered base and furnished interior; the flat roof reads as a thin lid, so it needs a little more depth and overhang to finish.
